description: Step 1 of adding a picture that is a file on your computer (PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 10 MB). Returns a one-time upload address: PUT the file's bytes there with its Content-Type, then call finish_project_picture with upload_id. rendering true (or a role) = one of the project's own pictures, shown large; item_id = that item's picture; neither = a project file. On a project Claude sources, role rendering shows it in the Design phase under its space (and its option), role layout in the Install phase. Owner only. Needs the owner's sign-in.

caption.description: The picture's title, e.g. "Lobby · front desk"

item_id.description: Item id, for an item's picture

option.description: For a rendering of a design option: its letter (A, B…), as on that option's items; empty clears

rendering.description: true for a final rendering of the project

role.description: rendering: a design picture, shown in the Design phase under its space; layout: an install map, shown in the Install phase

space.description: For a rendering: the space it shows, the same words as that space's item section, e.g. Lobby, Dragon's Den; empty clears

name: start_project_picture
title: Upload a picture file
